youtube.title: Draupadi ke ek chawal ke dane se hazaaron rishi kaise tript hue? 🍚 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Vanvaas mein Pandav Draupadi ke saath rehte the, aur Surya dev ne Yudhishthir ko ek Akshaya Patra diya tha. Jab tak Draupadi bhojan nahi karti, us patra mein anna kabhi khatam nahi hota tha. Ek din Duryodhan ke kehne par rishi Durvasa apne hazaaron shishyon ke saath aaye, tab Draupadi bhojan kar chuki thi aur patra khaali tha.

Draupadi ne Shri Krishna ko yaad kiya. Krishna aaye aur patra mein chipka hua ek chawal ka dana aur saag ka ek patta khaya. Unke tript hote hi door nadi par snaan kar rahe Durvasa aur shishyon ka pet bhar gaya, aur wo bina bhojan kiye laut gaye.

Katha ka strot: Mahabharata, Vana Parva (adhyay 263).
